items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And the next day, the leader of the band, a White

ctx.x: Anywhere. Everywhere. And we were traveling on the road, we run across... One time we run across some show people on the train (we was travelin' by train), and they was on a train from one of them small towns, and they were going to the same town we were going. So naturally, we all got acquainted. So they weren't working that night. They come to see us, you know, at the dance, one-thing-or-another. And naturally, Bud was playing, everybody was playing.
